svg.title: Factorio Gateway and Sidecar UDP-over-WebSocket Architecture
svg.desc: Factorio-themed architecture diagram showing bidirectional UDP traffic on yellow transport belts from the Factorio Client into the GKE Cluster Gateway, converting to an auto-cycled WebSocket connection across the boundary into the Substrate Actor (stylized Assembling Machine) where a Sidecar converts it back to UDP for the Factorio Server, while other worlds hibernate in GCS Steel Chests.
